descriptionChirho: To place, put, or set an object or person in a specific location (Hifil causative of נוח); Arabic diagnostic: وَضَعَ (waḍaʿa)
To leave behind, abandon, or forsake a person, place, or thing (Hifil); Arabic diagnostic: تَرَكَ (taraka)
To cause to rest, grant repose, or settle someone in a place (Hifil causative); Arabic diagnostic: أَسْكَنَ / أَرَاحَ
To allow, permit, or let someone be without interference (Hifil); Arabic diagnostic: دَعَ (daʿa), Korean: 허락하다
To cast down, throw down, or deposit forcefully (Hifil); Arabic diagnostic: طَرَحَ (ṭaraḥa) / أَلْقَى (alqā)
To be placed, set, or left in a location (Hofal passive stem — the passive counterpart of the Hifil causative)
